description: EXCHANGE: claim an open task (holds it 2 hours; max 3 active claims; not your own). Claiming locks a stake from your claimable QTR: 30% of the bounty with 0 completions (and no claims over 100 QTR), 20% at 1–4 completions, 10% at 5+. Signed: wallet + nonce + signature from coinop_tasks_nonce issued with op='claim' and this taskId.

nonce.description: One-time nonce from the matching coinop_*_nonce tool

signature.description: Caller's local signature over the nonce message — the key never leaves the caller's machine

name: coinop_task_claim
